# Reliability & Scale Requirements Checklist: Scheduled Surveys at HL Scale (001-scale-per-org)

**Purpose**: Pre-QA gate on the quality of the requirements for resuming, failure handling, recovery, scale and operations
**Created**: 2026-11-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md) · [contracts/run-due-surveys.md](../contracts/run-due-surveys.md) · ADR-011

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the populations covered by paging (All active customers, Active in a source during the period) both named, with no other scheduled population left unstated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the rules each customer goes through listed exhaustively (fatigue Drop/Postpone, priority, version pin, fixed expiry, Digital delivery), so "exactly the same rules as today" has a checkable list? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all fields of the trigger form's progress display specified, including which are shown only for scheduled triggers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Contract "Trigger form"]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the run statuses and every allowed transition between them (including Not sent → Stuck and Stuck → Sending) documented in one place? [Completeness, data-model.md state transitions]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the behaviour of the other daily passes (postponed release, retention) at HL volume stated as a requirement with its acceptance evidence, not only as a design note? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the per-org volumes stated with their source and date (HL ~44,000 / ~10,000 active; BFD/QDB1 ~450)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the configuration needed after deployment (Stuck After Failed Calls set on existing orgs) stated as a requirement or deployment precondition? [Gap, data-model.md Survey Settings]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "well inside the platform time limit" quantified (a page bound or a maximum call duration)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "evaluated" defined (invited + postponed + suppressed + already holding the invitation) so the count shown on the form is unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "the same run position" in the Stuck rule defined precisely enough to tell a repeat failure from progress followed by a new failure? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "a later day" for retrying a Stuck run defined relative to a stored date, so the retry moment can be determined? [Clarity, research R5, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the distinction between a foreseeable per-customer problem (logged and skipped) and a platform fault (whole call fails) stated with examples of each? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "one hour" in the performance target defined from a stated start moment ("the scheduler starting it") and per survey rather than per day? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Do the spec's status words (not started / running / completed / stuck) map one-to-one to the stored labels (Not sent / Sending / Sent / Stuck) everywhere they appear? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK015 Are FR-006 (a period completes before the next starts) and FR-010 (same-day surveys run in priority order) consistent when a trigger has both an unfinished previous period and a newly due one on the same day? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the accepted Drop → Fatigue label change (same-day surveys) reflected consistently in the spec, ADR-011 and FR-007's "same outcome" promise for ~450-customer orgs? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, ADR-011 Consequences]
- [ ] CHK017 Do the contract's Summary description and the spec's log requirement describe the same content? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Contract "Outputs"]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Can "no duplicates and no customer missing" be objectively measured with a stated method (count per customer per period)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the live-proof size (2,500) and the method for extrapolating to 10,000 stated, including what server timing is used? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, NFR-CSE-020]
- [ ] CHK020 Does SC-004 identify which "existing scheduled-survey test results" must be unchanged, including the one accepted label difference? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the evidence owner and format for the HL test-org timing defined (who runs it, what is recorded, where)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 Are recovery requirements defined for each interruption type: client stopped between calls, call cut by the budget, call failed and rolled back, scheduler down for days? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §US2, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for two overlapping scheduler calls working on the same run (only one advances)? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for a setup or trigger switched off part-way through a run, including what happens to invitations already created? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for a period that became due while its predecessor was Stuck, including when it starts once the predecessor finishes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, research R7 (T044)]
- [ ] CHK026 Is it specified that a period missed for another reason (trigger switched off over its due date) is NOT sent late, and which rule owns that case instead? [Coverage, Exception Flow, research R7]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 Is behaviour specified for customers leaving or joining the population between calls (evaluated at most once; a newly active customer behind the position not added)? [Edge Case, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Is behaviour specified when the Stuck threshold setting is empty (refused with a message, no built-in value)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011, Constitution V]
- [ ] CHK029 Is behaviour specified when a failure is recorded but no scheduled run is running or due (nothing recorded, and said so)? [Edge Case, Contract "Inputs"]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the misattribution case (postponed release fails while a scheduled run is next) documented as accepted, with how an administrator finds the real cause? [Edge Case, Assumption, research R5 (A1)]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK031 Are observability requirements stated for the run (what is written per page to the trace, what the scheduler log line contains)? [Non-Functional, Constitution XIV, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the monitoring signal defined (scheduler exit code on each failed call; Stuck on the form) and is "not complete after N calls" explicitly not a failure? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-011, scheduler README]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the audit expectation for the new run fields stated (change history kept on the trigger table)? [Non-Functional, Constitution VI]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the security posture stated as unchanged (no new permission, same scheduler role, run writes as SYSTEM)? [Non-Functional, plan Constitution Check VII]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK035 Is the assumed per-customer cost (~165 ms measured on cloud) recorded with its date and source, and is the requirement robust if HL's servers are slower? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK036 Are the prerequisites from earlier releases (15-minute scheduler, separate OneTime/Daily calls, 28-day catch-up) stated as dependencies? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the platform behaviour the design relies on (one transaction per call; rollback on failure; record ordering used for resuming) documented as an assumption with its evidence? [Assumption, research R3, R5]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK038 Is OQ-E3 (HL's monthly request volume) explicitly out of this feature's scope, with the reason, so it does not block acceptance? [Ambiguity, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK039 Are the out-of-scope items (customer-base filter, faster One-time send, event/milestone triggers) listed so reviewers do not read them as gaps? [Scope, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK040 Is it stated whether the scheduler change that also affects the One-time pass (not a failure after MaxCalls) is in or out of this feature's requirements? [Conflict, tasks T050, DEF-CSE-004]

## Notes

- Items are unchecked by design; the QA reviewer marks each after reading the requirement documents.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not change these markers.
- Focus: resuming, failure handling and recovery, plus scale/performance and operations. Depth: standard pre-QA gate.
